name: jot
description: Jot: a plain-text journal format, its parser, the site and the VS Code extension. Only the linter and the browser tests need these.

scripts.test:voice-writing: node --test site/test-voice-writing.mjs && node site/test-voice-writing-ui.cjs && node site/test-voice-local-ui.cjs
scripts.test:security: node --test parser/container-test.mjs parser/archive-test.mjs parser/lock-test.mjs site/test-passkey-client.mjs tools/test-privacy.mjs
scripts.test:security:browser: node site/test-lock-ui.cjs && node site/test-archive-ui.cjs && node site/test-browser-tools-ui.cjs
scripts.test:scribe: node --test site/test-scribe.mjs && node site/test-scribe-ui.cjs && node site/test-scribe-real-ui.cjs
